title: Create checklist progress service (persist step state + compute completion) for Console onboarding checklist
creator: Dylan Brooks
project: Guided onboarding + first production launch checklist
description:
Build the backend service that powers the Console onboarding checklist state.

Service responsibilities:
- Persist per-tenant checklist step state (not started / in progress / complete) with timestamps.
- Compute derived completion and milestone timestamps needed for KPI reporting and UI (e.g., “first success”, “ready for prod”, etc.).
- Handle idempotent writes and out-of-order events safely (no step regressions).
- Expose read APIs for the Console checklist UI (feature-flag gated).
- Expose a write-only internal ingestion interface for server-side event emission (gateway/control plane).

Non-goals for this ticket (tracked elsewhere):
- Support/admin overrides (ENG-5852)
- Backfill historical events/metrics (ENG-5844)
- Full in-product guided tours / remediation suggestions
acceptance_criteria:
Functional:
1) Console can call a stable read API to fetch checklist state for the current tenant (step list + status + timestamps + computed overall progress).
2) Gateway/control plane can send onboarding events to a write-only internal ingestion API.
3) Ingestion is idempotent:
   - repeated delivery of the same logical event does not duplicate state transitions
   - safe retries from callers are supported
4) Out-of-order events do not cause step regressions (step state must be monotonic).
5) State computation follows the v1 checklist template (step IDs) and the onboarding event schema v1.
6) Service has basic SLO instrumentation (request rate, error rate, latency) and logs sufficient for Support/SRE debugging.

Quality / ops:
7) Includes unit tests for state transitions + idempotency + out-of-order handling.
8) Includes an integration test (or contract test) that validates the event payload shape and required fields.
9) Data retention + payload review confirms we do not store PII fields (only tenant/account identifiers + event metadata allowed by schema).

Docs:
10) Minimal internal runbook: endpoints, auth requirements, expected failure modes, and how to validate correctness for a tenant.
implementation_notes:
Proposed architecture (MVP):
- New internal service: checklist-progress-service.
- Storage: Postgres (authoritative state) with a single “current state” table and an append-only audit table for debugging.
- API surface:
  - GET /v1/onboarding/checklist/state
    - Auth: Console-to-service (service token) + tenant context
    - Returns: checklist_version, steps[{id, status, first_completed_at, last_event_at}], overall_percent_complete, milestones
  - POST /internal/onboarding/events
    - Auth: gateway/control-plane service token
    - Body: onboarding-event-schema-v1 (subset) + required idempotency_key
    - Response: 202 (accepted) or 200 (already applied)

Event-to-step mapping:
- Map event_name -> step_id(s) in a config file pinned by checklist_version. This avoids hardcoding step logic across multiple callers.
- Derived milestones are computed server-side from step completion timestamps:
  - TTFS anchor: first_success_completed_at (derived from step “First successful request (2xx)”)
  - “Ready for production”: all required ‘prod’ steps complete OR explicit ‘launch-ready’ step complete (depending on template definition)

Idempotency + ordering:
- Require event.idempotency_key (caller generates; gateway can use request_id or hash(tenant_id + event_name + first_seen_at_bucket)).
- Persist applied idempotency keys with TTL window (e.g., 30 days) to prevent unbounded growth; also store per-step completion timestamps.
- Monotonic step transitions:
  - not_started -> in_progress -> complete only
  - complete is terminal; ignore later events that would reduce state
- Use emitted_at (from schema) for ordering decisions but never allow regressions. If emitted_at is missing or clock-skewed, fall back to received_at for last_event_at only.

Failure modes:
- If ingestion fails: callers can retry safely (idempotency key).
- If read API fails: Console should degrade to an “Unable to load checklist” state and avoid blocking core Console functionality.

Privacy:
- Store only: tenant_id, event_name, emitted_at, idempotency_key, step_id, status, and limited non-PII dimensions allowed by schema (e.g., sdk_lang, region).
- Do NOT store raw prompts, user inputs, IPs, or end-user identifiers.

Open questions (resolved during implementation):
- Whether we need an append-only audit log table in MVP vs only ‘current state’. Decision: include lightweight audit table (event_name + idempotency_key + received_at + applied_steps) for debugging dogfood issues.
- Whether to compute progress by replaying events (derived) vs persisting step state (event-driven). Decision per ADR: persist step state, with audit log for debugging; avoid expensive replays on read path.
testing:
Unit tests:
- Step state machine transitions (including terminal completion)
- Idempotency behavior (same key applied twice)
- Out-of-order events (complete then earlier in_progress)
- Multi-step mapping (one event completes multiple steps, if needed)

Integration/contract tests:
- Validate ingestion payload against onboarding-event-schema-v1 required fields
- Validate read response includes all steps in template for checklist_version

Manual verification checklist (dogfood):
- New tenant: no events => all steps not_started
- Create API key event => step updates
- First 2xx request event => TTFS milestone populated
- Streaming established event => streaming step completes
- Replay all events multiple times => no regressions, stable timestamps
rollout_plan:
1) Deploy behind feature flag (onboarding_checklist_enabled) for internal tenants only.
2) Enable dogfood cohort (DevEx + Console team accounts) and validate:
   - state transitions are correct
   - no duplicate state writes under retries
   - UI renders reliably
3) Expand to small external cohort per PM-768.
4) Add alerting on elevated 5xx on read endpoint and ingestion lag/errors.
5) Post-rollout: monitor ENG-5815 dashboards for funnel anomalies that may indicate mapping/logic bugs.

comments: 2025-02-10 — Dylan Brooks: Creating as core backend dependency for Console checklist MVP. Chloe to own service skeleton + API contract; Logan to review event schema alignment and cardinality constraints.
2025-02-12 — Logan Wright: Please keep ingestion payload minimal; don’t accept arbitrary metadata maps. Also need explicit versioning (checklist_version + schema_version).

2025-02-14 — Jada Williams: Strongly recommend monotonic per-step transitions. Dogfood will absolutely produce out-of-order events (gateway retries, async emit). Persisting current state + audit log seems right.

2025-02-18 — Marcus Lin: Flagging privacy: ensure we’re not storing user_id/end_user fields. Tenant/account IDs OK. Retention should follow onboarding telemetry policy; add delete path for account deletion events (even if not exposed to Console).

2025-02-24 — Chloe Martin: Implementing in Postgres with two tables: checklist_step_state and checklist_event_audit. Ingestion endpoint returns 200 if already applied idempotency key. Read endpoint returns full template steps (missing rows default to not_started).

2025-03-03 — Ethan Park: Control plane can emit ‘api_key_created’ event at creation time, but for ‘first 2xx’ it will come from gateway. Please ensure step mapping supports multiple producers without double-completing.

2025-03-12 — Chloe Martin: PR up with API + basic state machine + tests. Pending review from Dylan and Logan. Will follow up with alerting hooks after merge (SRE asked for request/err metrics at minimum).
2025-03-17 — Dylan Brooks: Reviewed PR-28431. Requested changes: include checklist_version in both read response and ingestion, and enforce allowed event_name list to avoid surprise cardinality.

2025-03-20 — Chloe Martin: Addressed review. Added allowlist + checklist_version required. Merged.
Follow-up: we’re seeing occasional step regressions in dogfood due to parallel ingestion writes (same step updated by different events). Spinning ENG-5866 to fix with stricter monotonic updates + per-step locking semantics.
2025-04-10 — Connor O'Brien: Marking Done for MVP backend deliverable; rollout gated and running for dogfood cohort. Admin override and race-condition hardening tracked separately.
